result:
**Verdict: FAIL.** One new High finding, plus F-DG0-102 stays open.

Before reviewing I confirmed the candidate. HEAD `4af07b03` is a later commit that only touches excluded metadata (assignments, manifest, `stages.json`). The ID recomputes to `sha256:31fd0843…cbf9` both from the working tree and from `540b3c69`. I ran all code in disposable worktrees, which I have removed. No tracked files were modified.

**My pending findings, each tested on the round-2 commit and on the candidate:**

| Finding | Result | Status after |
|---|---|---|
| F-DG0-101 (High) | PASS. Deleting a whole earlier review round is now caught. | CLOSED_VERIFIED |
| F-DG0-102 (High) | FAIL. The fix still has a gap (below). | **OPEN** |
| F-DG0-110 (High) | PASS. Closure now comes only from the reviewer's own verifications file. | CLOSED_VERIFIED |
| F-DG0-111 (Medium) | PASS. Tested through the real hook: a planted nested `.git` no longer unlocks protected paths. | CLOSED_VERIFIED |
| F-DG0-112 (Low) | PASS. File mode and file-vs-symlink type are now part of the candidate ID. | CLOSED_VERIFIED |
| F-DG0-113 (Low) | PASS. With `core.autocrlf=true`, the working-tree ID now matches the frozen ID. | CLOSED_VERIFIED |
| F-DG0-114 (Low) | PASS. The three documentation mismatches are corrected. | CLOSED_VERIFIED |

**Why F-DG0-102 stays open:** the check that a verification's run actually executed the right assignment is skipped when the verifying record has no `assignment` field (`rules.mjs:306`). That record is never checked against the review schema (`:466-467`), and the round doesn't have to list it. So a three-field record pointing at an unrelated run of the same role can close a High finding, and the gate still passes.

**New findings:**
- **F-DG0-115 (High, mandatory violation, owner delivery-orchestrator).** Review records and their findings and verifications files aren't tied to the run that wrote them. The history check at `rules.mjs:537-543` only catches deletions, although the error message calls the evidence append-only. The runner (`run-agent.sh:109-118`) doesn't record which files a run wrote. Editing already-committed review files in place lets three things through:
  - removing an unfixed High finding passes the gate, historical mode and the pipeline;
  - changing a reviewer's FAIL verification to PASS closes the finding;
  - changing a FAIL review verdict to PASS is accepted.

  My suggested fix has three parts. Reject modifications as well as deletions in the history check. Have the runner record the hash of every file a run writes. Make the validator match records and their companion files against that list. Nothing under `reviews/DG0` or `runs/DG0` has been modified or deleted in the real history so far, so the stricter rule wouldn't block DG0 itself.
- **F-DG0-116 (Low; I'd accept it as an observation).** In the working tree the file mode comes from the filesystem (`candidate.mjs:92`). On Windows-style checkouts (`core.fileMode=false`), executable scripts therefore change the candidate ID even though `git status` is clean. It fails closed, so it isn't a bypass.
- **F-DG0-117 (Low; I'd accept it as an observation).** A Low finding can be accepted as an observation from role names typed into `findings.json` alone (`rules.mjs:416-425`). No reviewer or auditor file is needed.

**Everything else I checked passed:**
- the candidate's own tests (37/37);
- `validate.mjs` register, pipeline and reconcile checks. `--stage DG0` fails as expected because there is no gate record yet;
- the source extraction check;
- the schemas use only keywords the validator supports;
- all 10 agent definitions match their hook settings;
- no secrets in the candidate or in the 25 committed transcripts;
- the CI workflow has read-only permissions, full history and pinned actions, and fails the job on a failed gate.

The runner, CI, write scopes, CSV parser and source scripts haven't changed since round 2.

Requirements checked: REQ-DLV-006, 007, 013, 015, 016, 017, 022, 023, 026.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG0/round-3/`:
- `code-security-reviewer.json` (validates against the review schema)
- `code-security-reviewer.findings.json`
- `code-security-reviewer.verifications.json`

The reproduction scripts and logs are in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/code-security/round-3/`.
